lines.text: MacGyver could fix anything with duct tape but which brand would he actually trust?
He rolls six tapes down with 25 pounds and hangs a jug that he fills with water until each one peels off.
T-Rex holds over 10 pounds which is twice as much as Gorilla and four times more than Scotch.
Because its glue is a thick soft rubber that flows into the tiny bumps of the surface and grips them.
beats: ai:extreme macro of thick sticky rubber adhesive flowing into tiny bumps on a surface

lines.text: Then he pulls each tape lengthwise with a lever and a weight plate until it snaps.
Gorilla holds almost 142 pounds while the cheapest tapes rip at 75 because its fabric mesh is woven much tighter.
beats: ai:macro of tightly woven grey fabric threads inside duct tape

lines.text: But tearing it across is a different story and Duck tape rips at just 12 pounds which is why you can tear it by hand.
So no tape wins everything and Gorilla is the best all rounder while T-Rex sticks the hardest.
